info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Treasury Analysis API
info.description: The Corporate Treasury Analysis API provides financial institutions with the tools to conduct thorough analyses of corporate treasury operations. This API facilitates the submission of detailed analysis requests, allowing users to evaluate liquidity management, cash forecasting, and risk assessment processes. It is primarily aimed at treasury analysts and finance professionals looking to optimize treasury strategies and improve fiscal responsibility. By leveraging this API, organizations can gain insights into their financial health and make data-driven decisions regarding treasury functions.

post.summary: Create a new corporate treasury analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new analysis within the corporate treasury framework. Users can provide necessary details in the request body to generate the analysis tailored to their needs.
